mutations.name: the build gets the network
kills: the host's closure.lock.json regeneration runs every branch command inside a sandbox with no network past the install and none of the host's environment

mutations.name: the sandbox inherits the host's environment
kills: the host's closure.lock.json regeneration runs every branch command inside a sandbox with no network past the install and none of the host's environment

mutations.name: a failed sandbox step is ignored
kills: the host's closure.lock.json regeneration stops at a failed build, names only the step, and still removes the scratch tree

mutations.name: a lock linked out of the scratch tree is read
mutations.find: if (!path.startsWith(`${root}${sep}`)) throw refusal("resolves outside the scratch tree");
kills: the host's closure.lock.json regeneration refuses a lock the sandbox linked to a file outside the scratch tree

mutations.name: the tree swaps the lock without a private index
kills: the host's closure.lock.json regeneration writes the merge's tree with only the lock's blob swapped, through a private index
